scope: One bounded read-only synthetic fixture/controller projection probe; no product edits, tests, build, Git mutation, native mutation, production/backend/account, browser, or external email.
expected_observation: A request captured with synthetic account email A is held; input draft changes to distinct synthetic email B; user navigates away and back while request is held; on successful fixture completion, the session/runtime authority remains A, route reentry remains login, and rendered input follows the existing authority projection A because the successful authority change clears the overlay. A result would warrant further investigation only if the actual authority/request identity diverges, or the route/draft behavior contradicts the documented authority-change policy; B clearing alone is not deemed a defect.
falsifier: Unexpected harness/setup failure; login fails despite synthetic registration+approval; service attempt count differs from one; runtime request/session binds to B instead of submitted A; or projection contradicts controller policy in a way that changes authenticated authority or leaks the ephemeral password.
run_limit: Exactly one invocation of the declared Node script. Preserve its original stdout, stderr, UTC timestamps, and exit status. Stop at first unexpected harness failure; do not retry or overwrite.
